name: Star Trek Las Vegas
blurb: Creation's five-day Star Trek convention in Las Vegas, the genre's largest, with cast autographs, panels, cosplay and photo ops at the Rio.

editions.evidence: Official calendar page (calendar.htm): 'Las Vegas, NV Aug. 4-8, 2027 - ST-LV:Trek to Vegas'; homepage events ticker: 'LAS VEGAS, NV Rio Las Vegas Hotel August 4-8, 2027'.

notes: Seed note said 'no 2026 edition found', but the 2026 STLV (Aug 5-9, 2026, sold out, at the Rio) did run — it is simply already over, before this research window; the 2027 date above is the correctly-identified next edition. The dedicated creationent.com/events/stlv-27/ page does not exist yet (confirmed 404; the still-live stlv-26 page says 'see you in Philadelphia this November', i.e. no 2027 guests posted yet), so guests is 'none-yet' and the cover uses the generic 'STLVGraphic' brand mark from the 2026 page rather than any single year's photo collage, since no 2027-specific art exists.
